snippet.title: Bloodthief - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
➤  WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533600/Bloodthief/

Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath.

Trailer by Saimizz
Music by Occams Laser
